gaps.lead: Fewer students enrolled this year than we expected.
gaps.explanation: fewer than expected = not as many (students) as expected.

gaps.lead: There's a rumour that the factory will close.
The ceremony will take place in the cathedral.
gaps.explanation: Ceremonies are held: will be held (in a venue).

gaps.lead: The party was incredibly boring, so we left early.
gaps.sentence: The party was ___ we left early.

gaps.lead: The guidebook says this bridge is Roman.
gaps.explanation: be supposed to be = generally said or believed to be.

gaps.lead: 'Don't touch the paintings in this room,' the guide warned us.
gaps.sentence: The guide warned ___ the paintings in that room.
gaps.explanation: Negative commands are reported with warned + object + not to + infinitive.
